description: Singapore total merchandise trade (imports + exports) by commodity section, monthly, in thousand dollars. Defaults to total trade; use `segment` to pick a sub-series: 'total' | 'oil' | 'non-oil' | 'petroleum' | 'oil-bunkers'. From EnterpriseSG/DOS via SingStat (M451001). Monthly series are fetched per-segment to avoid the API's cell limit.
name: sg_trade
